azc-admin-overtime-settings-layout: page-variant marker on styled azc-admin-policy-layout (overtime settings page)
azc-admin-policy-form__actions: BEM base; save-bar chrome carried by the --sticky modifier
azc-admin-policy-form__footer: button wrapper inside the styled --sticky actions bar
azc-admin-policy-form__sections: layout-transparent wrapper; card rhythm via .azc-card + .azc-card sibling margin
azc-admin-policy-live: aria-live region alias; styled via admin-notifications-live twin, JS selects both
azc-admin-vacation-policy-layout: page-variant marker on styled azc-admin-policy-layout (vacation policy pages)
azc-app--access-denied: page-variant marker on .azc-app root; layout owned by .azc-denied
azc-auto-clockout-badge: semantic marker on styled badge--info (auto-clockout flag)
azc-break-policy-summary: marker on styled azc-callout--info (break rules callout)
azc-bt-admin: page-variant marker on azc-page-stack (admin business trips)
azc-business-trips: page-variant marker on azc-page-stack (business trips surfaces)
azc-card__header--row: row-layout marker; base azc-card__header is already flex row
azc-dashboard-metric--balance: variant marker on styled azc-dashboard-metric; sign color via __value--positive/--negative
azc-dashboard-overnight: marker on styled azc-callout--info (overnight session notice)
azc-dashboard-punch__link: secondary action link inside styled azc-dashboard-punch__secondary
azc-entry-accounting__line--interruption: kind modifier on styled __line; interruption conveyed by __muted child text
azc-entry-accounting__line--segment: kind modifier on styled __line; value via __value child
azc-ext-stamps__btn: JS hook (querySelectorAll in external-stamps.js) on styled azc-btn
azc-filter-field__control--actions: actions variant marker on styled azc-filter-field__control; layout via page *-filter-actions
azc-get-app__features-block: layout-transparent section wrapper; children styled via azc-get-app__features
azc-get-app__play-label: label text inside styled azc-get-app__play / azc-get-app__store-link buttons
azc-input: generic input marker; chrome via paired azc-kiosk-modal__input / azc-kiosk-search__input
azc-input--touch: touch-target marker; 44px min-height already carried by the form-input recipe
azc-kiosk-last-seen: JS hook (admin-kiosk.js relative-time formatting) on table cell
azc-kiosk-overview: marker on styled azc-stat-strip (kiosk status strip)
azc-kiosk-revoke-terminal: JS hook (admin-kiosk.js revoke flow) on styled azc-btn--danger
azc-kiosk-stat: marker on styled azc-stat-tile; on/off state accents via --on/--off modifiers
azc-manager-trips: page-variant marker on azc-page-stack (manager business-trip queue)
azc-month-closure-lock: marker on styled azc-callout--info (month-closure notice, id-anchored)
azc-policy-rows__empty: empty-state paragraph; styled via form-help on the same element
azc-reports-stepper__label: step label text inside styled azc-reports-stepper__item
azc-section: redundant marker on styled azc-card (settings transfer sections)
azc-settings-nav--grouped: grouped variant marker on styled azc-settings-nav; groups via __group/__group-label
azc-transfer-report: dialog body wrapper; chrome via azc-dialog, verdict via azc-transfer-report__verdict
azc-work-location-badge: semantic marker on styled badge--* variants (work location)
